The '''mastiff phalone''', also known as '''mastif phalone''',<ref name="GaW" /> was a large, aggressive, carnivorous bird native to the savannas of [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Mastif_phalone_pair.png|thumb|left|250x250px|A pair of mastiff phalones stalking prey]]

The top predators of [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]],<ref name="TCWCE" /> mastiff phalones were quadrupedal pack hunters<ref name="Jedi Crash" /> about two meters long.<ref name="TCWCE" /> As flightless [[Bird/Legends|avians]]<ref name="GaW" /> mastiff phalones had turkey-like heads<ref name=":0">{{DB|creature|mastifphalone|mastiff phalone}}</ref> with a sharp beak, and a mane of large brown feathers.<ref name="Jedi Crash" /> Males used the feathers in courtship displays.<ref name="TCWCE" /> They had a muscular build with sharp talons large enough to wrap around a man's waist.<ref name="Jedi Crash" /> They were nearly as large as a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] and impossible to domesticate.<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

They tended to hunt in groups of two or more and used the tall grasses of Maridun's savannas as cover.<ref name=":0" /> They were fierce but tended to retreat from an attack if the prey was too powerful, only to later attack the same prey again.<ref name="Jedi Crash" /> When sufficiently agitated, a mastif phalone could be more dangerous than a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] and just as hard to bring down.<ref name="GaW" /> The immigrated [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] had found a peaceful way of dealing with them by a group effort of having several Lurmen distract the mastiff phalone, while one of the group took a rope and tied it around the its legs, immobilizing the creature. The Lurmen later released the captive mastiff phalone back into the wild.<ref name="Jedi Crash" />

==History==
Mastiff phalones descended from flying creatures, with their wings evolved back into powerful limbs.<ref name="TCWCE" />

The [[Amani/Legends|Amanin]] of [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] frequently captured mastif phalones and imprisoned them, starving them and mistreating them while in captivity. Once the mastif phalone was sufficiently crazed, the Amanin released the creature in or near enemy encampments, where it went berserk, attacking anything it saw.<ref name="GaW" />

At least a mastiff phalone was hunted and killed by [[Garnac's hunting guild/Legends|Garnac's hunting guild]]. Its pelt was later placed in their [[Ubrikkian Floating Fortress]].<ref name="Wookiee Hunt">{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}</ref>

A group of mastiff phalones ambushed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] party of [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] and three [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], One also attacked [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] at their crash site. Rex narrowly escaped this attack, and allowed it to run off and bring back a second mastiff phalone, both of which attacked the crash site. Rex killed one with his blaster, but the second evaded the blaster fire. The mastiff phalone destroyed Skywalker's tent and prepared to kill Skywalker. Tano, Bly and a Lurmen healer named [[Wag Too/Legends|Wag Too]] then arrived. As Ahsoka went to strike down the beast, Wag stopped her with a warning and tied a rope to its legs. Together with Ahsoka and Rex, they pulled the rope, tipping the creature on its side to be tied up.<ref name="Jedi Crash">{{TCW|Jedi Crash}}</ref>
